mutation_summary: The short-lived existing-project bootstrap enables this fixed Phase 8 public-service superset idempotently; generated deployment credentials can inspect but cannot change service state, and cleanup leaves the shared APIs enabled.
limitations: The first supervised live gate covers only an existing billing-enabled project; organization/project-creation mode requires a separate ownership contract.
The prerequisite Service Usage, IAM, and Cloud Resource Manager APIs must already be available before the dedicated bootstrap identity can be created and inspected.
Enabling an API creates no Twin workload but can create Google-managed service agents in the target project.
The baseline is intentionally a non-cost-optimized PoC superset for all supported Phase 8 provider placements.
